sponsored.t: Relates to disposal of radioactive waste
sponsored.sum: Provides that all waste containing source, byproduct, or special nuclear material shall be hazardous waste.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a county representation system for electing the governor and lieutenant-governor within the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a county representation system for electing the governor and lieutenant-governor within the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the confinement of companion animals in vehicles in extreme temperatures
sponsored.sum: Relates to the confinement of companion animals in vehicles in extreme temperatures; provides such animals may be rescued if certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Relates to comptroller oversight of tribal-state compacts prior to federal approval
sponsored.sum: Directs the comptroller to review and provide a recommendation of approval or modifications, for submission for federal approval of any tribal-state compact approved or executed between the state of New York, the governor, or their designee and an Indian nation or tribe.

sponsored.t: Requires ad hoc members to be appointed in order to constitute a quorum
sponsored.sum: Requires ad hoc members to be appointed in order to constitute a quorum on the board of electric generating facilities; includes ad hoc members as part of the board.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the village of Lewiston to reduce the speed limit to 25 miles per hour on Center Street
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the village of Lewiston to reduce the speed limit to 25 miles per hour on Center Street.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees for hunting, fishing and trapping licenses
sponsored.sum: Relates to fees for hunting, fishing and trapping licenses; provides free fishing, hunting and trapping licenses for certain members of the military.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of failure to retreat
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of failure to retreat when a person who is within twenty-five feet of a police officer or peace officer engaged in the performance of their duties and the police officer or peace officer orders such person to halt or retreat and the person fails to do so immediately; requires the posting of bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sharing of revenue from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara
sponsored.sum: Provides that $1,600,000 of any funds from gaming devices located within the county of Niagara shall be transferred to the Niagara county industrial development agency for use to fund downtown economic development initiatives within the city of Niagara Falls.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of aggravated offering of a false accusation against a police officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of aggravated offering of a false accusation against a police officer or peace officer for knowing the information reported to be false or baseless, such person reports, by word or action, to a law enforcement officer or agency, the wrongdoing by a police officer or peace officer in the performance of such officer's duties; requires the posting of bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to free use of state parks and campsites for volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance service
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides free use of state parks and campsites for volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance service.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time period which an application for refund can be made when the refund is based on a clerical error or unlawful entry
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time period in which an application for refund can be made when the refund is based on a clerical error or unlawful entry by allowing a full refund without time limitation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to certain hospitals
sponsored.sum: Establishes the power authority of the state of New York shall make low cost hydropower available to hospitals and municipal housing authorities located within Niagara County.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state thruway authority to discontinue the collection of tolls at the Grand Island bridges in the Niagara section of the thruway
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state thruway authority to discontinue the collection of tolls at the Grand Island bridges in the Niagara section of the Governor Thomas E. Dewey Thruway.

sponsored.t: Establishes tuition awards for members of the reserve armed forces of the United States
sponsored.sum: Establishes tuition awards for members of the reserved armed forces of the United States; provides eligibility for such tuition benefit shall be determined by the education services offices of the division of military and naval affairs; restricts such tuition benefit to legal residents of the state; establishes a tuition award account.

sponsored.t: Provides for a New York power authority trustee from Niagara county
sponsored.sum: Provides that the next appointed trustee of the power authority of New York state shall be from Niagara county and provides for a permanent trustee from such county on such authority.

sponsored.t: Enacts Noah's Law; creates the crimes of child abuse, vulnerable elderly person or incompetent or physically disabled person abuse, and torture
sponsored.sum: Creates the crimes of child abuse, vulnerable elderly person or incompetent or physically disabled person abuse, and torture.

sponsored.t: Relates to police staffing at certain parks
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation to provide for the health, safety and welfare of the public using facilities under its jurisdiction, which shall include ensuring a minimum staff of three hundred eighty-five permanently appointed, full time regional state park police officers at state parks, beaches, campgrounds, historic sites and concert venues; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires certain child day care centers to have video surveillance
sponsored.sum: Requires certain child day care centers to have video surveillance in certain areas occupied by children who are three years of age or younger.

sponsored.t: Eliminates daylight savings time; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates daylight savings time.

sponsored.t: Relates to the tribal-state compact revenue account
sponsored.sum: Relates to monies appropriated and received each year by the state as a portion of the negotiated percentage of the net drop from electronic gaming devices the state receives.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Niagara Falls to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy.

sponsored.t: Waives the thirty day residency requirement for certain hunting licenses for active duty military members and their families on permanent orders to be stationed within the state
sponsored.sum: Waives the thirty day residency requirement for certain hunting licenses for active duty military members and their families on permanent orders to be stationed within the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"; requires fifty percent of parking revenue generated at state parks in the county of Niagara to be deposited in the Niagara parks reinvestment fund; establishes the Niagara parks reinvestment fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing an unsupervised or unattended minor from a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing an unsupervised or unattended minor from a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Provides free use of state parks to family members of deceased military
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides free use of state parks to family members of deceased military; requires rules and regulations for timely implementation.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of harassment of a first responder
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of harassment of a first responder as a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Relates to ethics reform
sponsored.sum: Relates to ethics reform, term limits on certain positions in the legislature, limits on campaign contributions, directing stare funds, and creating a database of state contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing public welfare officials to withhold payment of rent to landlords who owe delinquent tax liabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing public welfare officials to withhold payment of rent to landlords who owe delinquent tax liabilities to local municipalities, school districts or counties.

sponsored.t: Replaces the word rape with the term sexual battery
sponsored.sum: Replaces the word rape with the term sexual battery.

sponsored.t: Makes sex trafficking a violent felony
sponsored.sum: Relates to making the crimes of sex trafficking and sex trafficking of a child violent felonies.

sponsored.t: Requires curriculum or instruction in Italian history and civic impact
sponsored.sum: Requires curriculum or instruction in Italian history and civic impact in all public school districts in the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to Rajendra Sharma
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Niagara to continue to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Niagara to continue to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes.
